exchanges: ok so i need to talk this through because my head is spinning
Go ahead, I'm listening.

minjun fell off his skateboard yesterday at the park and his wrist swelled up like a balloon and we spent four hours in urgent care, they think its just sprained, but hes so dramatic about everything that i honestly cant tell if its bad or not
Four hours in urgent care is exhausting. Swelling like that is worth watching even if it's minor.
yeah. and of course his band concert is next week and he plays trumpet so who knows
That depends a bit on which wrist. Which one is it?
left, thank god
That's lucky, at least for the concert.
his band teacher mr osei said he can still sit in even if he cant play
That's kind. At least he won't miss the whole experience.
yuna has her piano exam the same week, its like the universe hates me
Two big events in one week is a lot. How's she feeling about the exam?
confident which scares me. her teacher ms beatriz says shes ready
If her teacher says she's ready, she probably is. Confidence helps on exam day.
true. ok random but my brother joon is visiting this weekend, hes obsessed with rock climbing now and wants to take minjun to the climbing gym which obviously is not happening with his wrist
Definitely not this weekend. Maybe Yuna would want to go instead?
she might! shes fearless
A fearless nine-year-old and an uncle like that sounds like a good match.
lol. my husbands brother carlos is the opposite, he does pottery, very zen. he made us a whole set of bowls for christmas
That's a thoughtful gift. Handmade bowls are special.
they are but theyre kinda lopsided lol
Lopsided adds character.
ok so urgent care just called back. they looked at the xray again and its not sprained its a small fracture, so cast for 4 weeks
Oh no, that changes things. Four weeks in a cast is a lot for a skater.
hes actually thrilled, he wants everyone to sign it
That's the upside of a cast at thirteen.
his best friend tomas already drew a dragon on it
A dragon is a strong start.
yeah tomas is an artist, his mom is a tattoo artist so it runs in the family
That makes sense. He must have grown up around drawing.
ok so do i email mr osei about the concert or just let minjun tell him
A short email from you is probably best, so it's official.
ok ill do that tonight
Good plan.
yuna also has a loose tooth and she keeps wiggling it at dinner which is disgusting
Loose tooth wiggling at the table is a rite of passage, sadly.
she wants the tooth fairy to bring her a pokemon card instead of money
That's a very specific request.
the tooth fairy is gonna have to go to walmart lol
The tooth fairy shops wherever she needs to.
my mom is coming to help next week too, she used to be a nurse so shell fuss over the cast nonstop
Having someone with that background around might make you feel better about it too.
shell also cook for days, she always brings kimchi
Homemade kimchi is the best kind of help.
the whole fridge is gonna smell amazing
Worth it.

questions.message: whats my brother in law into these days
what instrument does minjun play again
minjuns wrist is just a sprain right
what was my moms job back in the day
what does mr osei do for fun outside school
i better clear a shelf for all that kimchi
